title: DFE compatibility profile
description: A versioned block of first-hop rule rows that reads a platform's own header fields into the DFE header. What a row means is scalo.rules' format, checked by scalo.rules itself.

id.description: The file name without .yaml. A source binds a revision as <id>@<version>.

resource_type.description: core ships in this package and refuses edits. custom is an operator's own.

current.description: The version a binding with no revision takes.

versions.description: Each version is a complete snapshot, and a published one never changes.

name.description: Lower case words joined by hyphens, short enough that the engine can prefix a rule id with it inside the rule engine's 128-character id.

header_field.description: The scalar header fields a profile may set. Moving a subtree or reshaping a payload is a transform's job.

type.description: SchemaVer: model is a major change, addition a minor one, revision a patch.

title.description: The name the UI shows for the profile.

description.description: The UI tooltip: what the profile reads and what it sets.

covers.description: The senders the profile reads, shown as a chip.

targets.description: The header fields the rows set, in evaluation order. _source comes before _org_id so an org row can test the source the same pass chose.

lookups.description: Lookup tables the rows read. A shipped table may be empty: the engine fills it from each registered source before it compiles the rows.

rules.description: The rows, in the order they fire. Fixed by the revision: copy the profile into a custom one to reorder them.

opt_in.description: Ids of rows the engine leaves out until a source opts in to them.

version.description: A version range of the platform, when the profile reads only some of them.

when.description: A scalo.rules CEL Fast condition, in place of match.

set.description: Exactly one header field and the scalo.rules action that finds its value.
